I'm deleting my Reddit account in the near future, I haven't made many contributions to the hunt, but I'll re-post the following:

I'm making this post because some believe yoga may play in part in unlocking this mystery.

Since the first time I've done yoga in GTA5, I've always wondered if I was "doing it right"... On PS3, the analog sticks and triggers (L2 & R2) are used; I assume it's also analog inputs on Xbox. Apparently, doing yoga improves M's strength, lung capacity, and maybe stamina (don't remember); plus, it fills up his ability bar. Side note: I wonder if doing yoga on the mountain, higher altitude, boosts the stats more? When the session is done, I don't think yoga gives you a score or an indication of success/failure, does it? Failing the mission "did anybody say yoga" does gives the message : "Michael failed to reach enlightenment"; but I'm talking about the yoga "mini-game" specifically. *I can't play my ps3 right now, to "mess up" a yoga session to try to see a fail message, but I'm sure someone here already knows...

Anyway, I've been trying to see if there was any feedback from the game to let players know if they were doing it correctly. I've noticed that, for me, when M tries to do this pose, in which one hand and one foot are on the ground, he's always kinda struggling a bit. Considering that the player inputs are analogue, could it perhaps be that the sticks/triggers aren't meant to be pushed in all the way? Is it possible that the inputs are meant to be done slow vs fast when transitioning from one pose to the next? Same question for pressing/releasing the triggers for inhalation exhalation (fast vs slow) and WHEN do you start pressing/releasing them...

So, I was wondering what are your experiences and perceptions of success doing yoga. Does your M transition smoothly from one pose to the next or is he struggling and stumbling a bit? Do you think it's because of "controller technique" or maybe the game keeps count of how many times you've done yoga and M improves with practice? Maybe he always struggles with that pose and always will, for everybody.

I usually held the sticks in place during the breathing and input the next position when the prompt comes up but I guess you can release the sticks at some point .

Thanks for reading

Well. Nevermind the altitude training...

Loaded up 100% save and checked stats, which became my control save. And then I did yoga 3 times in a row on Mount Gordo, made a new save and re-loaded the game I just saved, just to make sure the stats updated on social club and noted the changes (gordo yoga). Since I have 100 a lot of places, you can't really tell if those are affected or not... After that, I loaded up my original save (strength 66), confirmed that stats were back to pre-gordo yoga on social club, and did yoga 3 times in a row at M's house. I made a new save, re-loaded and checked social club (safehouse yoga). And then, I was pissed off.

Skills stats changes after doing yoga 3 times at each site. M's stats Control save gordo yoga safehouse yoga special 100 100 100 stamina 100 100 100 shooting 100 100 100 strength 66 72 75 stealth 99 99 99 flying 102 102 102 driving 100 100 100 lung 100 100 100

I don't want to say yet that doing yoga in a certain site increases stats more than at the other because maybe I made less mistakes when I did it at the safehouse. In my testing, I did gordo first and maybe I became better at movement/breathing "controler technique" by the time I did yoga at the safehouse.

My next plan is to do this exercise again, from my strength 66 save, but doing the safehouse yoga first and gordo after. That way, we will also see if doing "yoga 3X stats change" is always the same for each site. If it's not, then the technique really does make a difference, but the reason for Gordo yoga location continues to be mysterious.

Edit: I did the same thing again; yoga 3 times at both sites, starting with safehouse, and then gordo. Followed the same methodology, but the stats changes were exactly the same at both sites; strength went from 66 to 75. I figure that I messed up my gordo yoga a bit in my first trials, which could by why strength only went up to 72. Well, If anything, this exercise showed that how "well" yoga is done affects how much the skills stats increase. The location doesn't seem to have any link to the skills stats variation.
